hypothesis: BMP/SMAD activity, through WNT4, is necessary for hormone-induced stromal decidualization.
evidence: ET-013 (SMAD1/5 siRNA impairs decidualization; BMP2 rescue); ET-008 (BMP2-WNT4); ET-004 (mouse Bmp2)
discriminating_readouts: PRL and IGFBP-1 (RNA and secreted) fall under BMP receptor inhibition confirmed by pSMAD1/5/8 loss.

logic: S_PGR and S_CEBPB and not S_JNK
hypothesis: Progesterone- and cAMP-responsive pathways maintain decidualization despite BMP inhibition.
discriminating_readouts: PRL and IGFBP-1 unchanged under BMP receptor inhibition despite pSMAD1/5/8 and WNT4 loss.

hypothesis: Progesterone suppresses epithelial proliferation through stromal HAND2 and a stromal paracrine mitogen acting on epithelial FGFR-ERK.
evidence: ET-005 (mouse); ET-007 (human, FGF9 only); ET-029 (stromal ERalpha mediates E2 mitogenesis)
discriminating_readouts: Ki67/EdU rise after stromal HAND2 knockdown; fall when the paracrine route is blocked during E2 priming.

logic: E_ESR1 and E_FGFR_ERK and not S_HAND2
hypothesis: Legacy v0.5.1 representation: the relay plus a direct HAND2 term. Same composed Boolean function as Q2_stromal_relay; differs only in transient dynamics.
discriminating_readouts: None at steady state; only time-resolved Ki67/EdU after progestin onset.

hypothesis: Epithelial-autonomous explanation: epithelial PGR activity suppresses E2-driven proliferation without stromal mediation.
evidence: No primary paper in the corpus supports an epithelial-autonomous route; included as the alternative the grant asks about.
discriminating_readouts: Ki67/EdU unchanged by stromal HAND2 knockdown or paracrine blockade.

hypothesis: IL-1beta impairs decidualization through JNK without depleting stromal PGR activity.
discriminating_readouts: pSMAD1/5/8, HAND2, WNT4 and IRF4 unchanged by IL-1beta under hormone treatment.

hypothesis: IL-1beta additionally depletes stromal PGR through ERK1/2, which removes HAND2, BMP2/SMAD and IRF4 support and releases the stromal paracrine mitogen.
evidence: ET-015 (ERK1/2-dependent PR depletion in human ESC); ET-012; ET-017
discriminating_readouts: pSMAD1/5/8, HAND2, WNT4 and IRF4 fall under IL-1beta; FGF9 rises.

hypothesis: PRL induction needs FOXO1, through the FOXO1-licensed PR target IRF4.
evidence: ET-027 (IRF4 knockdown attenuates PRL); ET-022 (FOXO1 knockdown lowers PRL)
discriminating_readouts: PRL (RNA and secreted) falls under FOXO1 inhibition, like IGFBP-1.

hypothesis: PRL induction does not need FOXO1 activity; only IGFBP1 does.
evidence: ET-024 (FOXO1 activity inhibitor: IGFBP1 collapses, PRL unchanged); ET-026 (FOXO1 alone inert on the PRL enhancer); ET-023
discriminating_readouts: PRL unchanged while IGFBP-1 falls under FOXO1 inhibition.
